name: Spiritual Leadership
overview: Spiritual leadership, as revealed in Scripture, centers on servant-hearted oversight grounded in the Spirit's guidance. Jesus contrasts worldly authority with the humble, caring leadership He models, calling leaders to feed and protect the church purchased by His blood. This leadership involves mutual submission among believers, with specific instructions for male spiritual leadership within the family, emphasizing Christlike love and responsibility. True spiritual leaders hear Christ’s voice and lead by His example, relying on the life-giving power of His Spirit.
